_doc: Copy to $WILLOW_HOME/willow-bot/operator.json (or point WILLOW_BOT_OPERATOR_PROFILE at it). Every key is optional; an absent key is discovered from GitHub where it can be (login: gh api /user; orgs: your org memberships) and is otherwise empty. See willow_bot/operator_profile.py.
